items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: He was telling Lomax about playing there... And Lomax coming up, he says, did you?

ctx.x: I didn't know such thing. He said, I'm the man that carried that. He carried that into Kansas City.

Kansas City Jazz. I don't know whether you read it or not. I wrote that first little thing I wrote for the record changer was just a little paragraph about Johnny being in New York. And he went to a nightclub where a couple of boogie woogie players were the star attraction. I guess they were the only thing there. And they were playing the boogie woogie stuff. And Johnny got persuaded to give a few examples of his stuff. You know, he played and went over all right. And he was telling Lomax about playing there, you…
Why shouldn't he tell the term of that? He's probably talking about Ammons and Johnson.
